messages:
Alex P.: quick thread — StratusWorks + EdgeBox co-webinar confirmed for Tue 4/12 9AM PT. Need: final speaker list, live demo plan, attendee swag plan.
Marina (Events): sounds good. do we have run-of-show? i'm building slides. who owns kit shipping?
Jordan (Eng): I can run the live demo (Redwood + EdgeBox on-prem sync). need a reproducible script and a fallback recording.
Sam_devops: can we get a dedicated test pool in eu-west1 for the demo? want to avoid quota thrash.
Rebecca (Partnerships): shipping: StratusWorks will send 50 swag boxes; we (Redwood) handle custom stickers + quickstart cards. deadline: ship by 4/5.
Alex P.: @Jordan agree on fallback. @Sam_devops pls confirm test pool by EOD tomorrow. @Marina can you own the shipping manifest?
Marina (Events): yes i'll own manifest. draft below — pls comment:
```json
{
  "kits":50,
  "items":["sticker pack","quickstart card","lanyard","EdgeBox mini-card"],
  "ship_by":"2026-04-05"
}
```
Jordan (Eng): demo script rough:
1) deploy model to Redwood Dedicated
2) route inference to local EdgeBox via smart-routing
3) show latency before/after caching
I'll drop a runnable snippet in #eng-releases later.
Sam_devops: test pool done — eu-west1:g4dn-reserve-2 for Tue morning. added a temporary firewall rule for EdgeBox IP range.
Rebecca (Partnerships): added StratusWorks speaker: Lina C. + EdgeBox engineer: Marco. Lina will do live arc; Marco does hardware handoff.
Alex P.: swag checklist: Marina + Rebecca to approve final packing list by 4/1. Also need customs docs for EU shipments — @Marina pls sync with finance.
Marina (Events): noted. i'll attach HS codes and invoice template.
Jordan (Eng): fallback plan: if live hardware fails, we stream a pre-recorded demo and switch to Q&A. I'll prep the recording and host it on s3.
Alex P.: perfect. final asks before I close: (1) run-of-show timeline (Marina) (2) demo runnable + recording (Jordan) (3) shipping manifest + customs (Marina+Rebecca) (4) infra test pool (Sam_devops)
Marina (Events): I'll circulate run-of-show tomorrow. :party_parrot:
Rebecca (Partnerships): I'll confirm speaker slides and share bios for promo.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-04-10 07:00UTC — all clear
Sam_devops: small note — we need to blacklist demo traffic from observability alerts, else PagerDuty goes off.
Alex P.: good call. Sam please add rule and ping ops.
Sam_devops: added suppression rule; notified ops on the ticket #6172.
Jordan (Eng): dropping the initial demo script link: https://rwd.internal/edge-demo/v1
Marina (Events): thanks everyone — i'll update the calendar invite with the final run-of-show once Jordan's recording is uploaded.
Alex P.: closing thread later today unless blockers. :thumbsup:
